scope: Rewrite cache storage/lease API in idiomatic Rust. Keep slot layout, generation and replacement decisions, atomic ordering, search algorithms and weights. Preserve all original attribution. This is not an independence or unrecognizability claim.

gates.native: Meaningful cache state/replacement/concurrency/lifetime checks plus all existing release and debug tests; formatting
gates.deterministic: 2497913 canonical nodes and all 51 normalized bench searches; 64 depth-nine comparisons and baseline tactical agreement
gates.independent: Independent rule/perft/special edges; browser/SSE and proof smoke checks; ready/stop/hash-resize with multiple threads

timing.order: AB/BA alternating, one warm bench each
timing.scope: Desktop same-work engineering measurement, no guarantee of exact speed or playing strength. Retain a failed candidate/report rather than tune to its results.

matches.decision: All 96 games independently audited. Reject if the opening-pair bootstrap 95% upper score bound is below 50%; no Elo/superiority inference and no adaptive extension.

outstanding: The rest of the core is still inherited. This stage does not fulfill a full independent-engine rewrite.
